detailed_description: CSP Header Generator - Build a Content-Security-Policy header from common directive fields such as default-src, script-src, style-src, img-src, connect-src, frame-ancestors, report-uri, and upgrade-insecure-requests. The tool cleans each directive value, combines the non-empty fields into one header line, and lets you copy the result for review in your web server or application configuration.
usage_steps: Fill in the source lists you want for each CSP directive
Review the generated Content-Security-Policy header and directive count
Copy the header and test it carefully before using it on a production site
usage_examples: Create a starter policy with default-src 'self' and a CDN in script-src
Add frame-ancestors 'none' while reviewing clickjacking protection
Include a report-uri value when drafting a policy for staged CSP reporting

faqs.question: Is the CSP Header Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does it validate my whole website policy?
faqs.answer: No. It builds a header string from the values you enter. You should still test the policy against your real pages and browser console reports.

faqs.question: Can I copy the generated header directly?
faqs.answer: You can copy it as a draft, but review each directive first because a strict CSP can block scripts, styles, images, or frames your site depends on.
